# Point-in-time snapshot of Cropwright's (the labeler frontend's)
# executable HTTP call sites, as of wt-cropwright-integration commit
# 90baa9b on branch feat/backend-integration.
#
# Paths here are PREFIX-STRIPPED (the frontend's literal `/curation/...`
# prefix is removed -- the app-side comparison strips the backend's
# configured `api_prefix` the same way, see test_labeler_route_parity.py)
# and PARAM-NORMALIZED (any `${...}`-interpolated URL segment is written as
# the literal token `{param}`). Deduplicated and sorted.
#
# Regenerate the raw candidate list with:
#   rg -o "/curation/[A-Za-z0-9_./{}$-]+" \
#     <cropwright-checkout>/src/lib/api.ts \
#     <cropwright-checkout>/src/lib/sse.ts \
#     <cropwright-checkout>/src/routes/export/+page.svelte \
#   | sort -u
#
# That one-liner over-matches comments and JSDoc (rg doesn't know Cropwright's
# comment syntax) -- hand-filter against the executable/comment-only split
# before updating this file, then strip the `/curation` prefix, collapse
# `${...}` interpolations to `{param}`, dedupe, and sort. Update this
# header's commit hash when you do.
#
# Excluded on purpose (see KNOWN_GAPS in test_labeler_route_parity.py for
# the authoritative list + reasons -- do not re-add these without removing
# the matching KNOWN_GAPS entry):
#   /export/<proprietary>            -- proprietary single-class export, never ported
#   /export/<proprietary>/status     -- ditto
#
# Two more exclusions were removed once their paired frontend fixes landed:
# /crops/{param}/plate_thumbnail (now /crops/{param}/region_thumbnail
# below) and /vlm-vendor/label_batch (now /vlm/label_batch below).
#
# Work item B2 (LPR vocabulary off the public API) renamed the ten
# /plates/... call sites below to /regions/..., plus /crops/{param}/plate ->
# /crops/{param}/region and /crops/{param}/plate_meta ->
# /crops/{param}/region_meta -- an agreed breaking change, so those entries
# were hand-edited here to the new paths ahead of the matching Cropwright
# commit rather than re-snapshotted. Re-snapshot as usual once the frontend
# change lands.
